items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Gee, I remember Punch when he was here, and we worked with Punch

ctx.x: Punch Miller. Gee, I remember Punch when he was here, and we worked with Punch, and then Francois Mosely, I used to see him all the -- he had a band that called themselves the Louisianians. And he had a whole New Orleans band. Yeah. And almost all of the musicians from New Orleans -- we all mingled very close that year. So -- but they were very clannish, they stayed together. And they acted a little strange, like you said.
Zutty stopped talking to Louis or something because Zutty was the oldest -- this was later, of course, and Zutty was the oldest and therefore he had inherited the leadership or something.
